questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The incident was narrated by somebody to Naresh.

options.text: Somebody was narrating the incident to Naresh.
Somebody narrated the incident to Naresh.
Somebody was about to narrate the incident to Naresh.
Somebody will narrate the incident to Naresh.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Somebody narrated the incident to Naresh**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from **passive to active voice**.

 
 
• The **agent **in the passive voice becomes the subject(doer of the action) of the active voice.
 
• In the given sentence, "**somebody**" becomes the **subject **in the active voice.
 
• We can omit the usage of "**by**" in the active voice. We use the preposition "by" to show the **agent **in the passive voice.
 
• We can also omit the usage of "to be" forms in the active voice. So we can omit "**was**" which is the past tense of "to be" in the given sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the **simple past tense.**
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

​The correct sentence is: *Somebody narrated the incident to Naresh.*

• **passive voice** में एजेंट **active voice** का विषय (कार्रवाई का कर्ता) बन जाता है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, "somebody" सक्रिय आवाज में विषय बन जाता है।
 
• हम **active voice** में "by" के उपयोग को छोड़ सकते हैं। एजेंट को **passive voice** में दिखाने के लिए हम "by" **preposition **का उपयोग करते हैं।
 
• हम active voice में **"****to be**" फॉर्म के उपयोग को भी छोड़ सकते हैं।
 
• इसलिए हम "was" को छोड़ सकते हैं जो दिए गए वाक्य में "**to be**" का भूत काल है।

The pie-chart given below shows the monthly expenditures made by a family under different heads as percentages of the total monthly income of the family. If the total monthly income of the family is ₹70,000, then what is the amount that is left with the family after only the food and medical expenditures for the month are made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0762f823fb7f763a92e41260de604191ce238814df60a3a9122fd46d0f153851.png]
questions.solution:
Given:

Total monthly income of a family = Rs 70,000

Percentage of expenditure for food = 28%

Percentage of expenditure for house rent = 14%

Percentage of expenditure for child education = 25%

Percentage of expenditure for medical = 10%

Percentage of expenditure for entertainment = 8%

Percentage of expenditure for provident fund = 15%

Concept Used:

Income left = Total Income – Income Spend

Calculation:

Amount spent on food = 28% of 70,000

Amount spent on food = (28)/(100) × 70000 = Rs 19,600

Amount spent on medical = 10% of 70,000

Amount spend on medical = (10)/(100) × 70000 = Rs 7,000

Total amount spent in food and medical = Rs 19,600 + Rs 7,000 = Rs 26,600

• **Dmitri Mendeleev **devised the periodic classification of the **chemical elements**, in which the **elements **were **arranged **in **order of increasing atomic weight**.
